caption: Our five help articles for a made up snowboard store, all published. These five were the only content Fin could answer from.
Fin's one wrong answer: it said the store does not carry helmets, although none of our articles says so, and it listed Content (4) as its source.
The Batch Test runs a list of questions at once. Every question got an answer and 9 of 10 were right; the rating column stays Unrated until you score them yourself.
Build your plan on annual billing during the trial: Essential $19, Advanced $85 and Expert $132 per seat a month for new customers. One Advanced seat came to $1,020 a year before tax.
On monthly billing the new customer offer is 25% off Essential, $29 instead of $39 a seat. Advanced stays at $99 and Expert at $139. Our research notes did not have the $29 price.
Billing during the free trial: Advanced with 14 days left, ending 3 December 2026, plus three add-ons on trial. With no card on file the trial simply runs out.
